maddeler.e:
أنهمر (form VII)
# أَنْهَمِرُ (ʔanhamiru) /ʔan.ha.mi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# أَنْهَمِرَ (ʔanhamira) /ʔan.ha.mi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
# أَنْهَمِرْ (ʔanhamir) /ʔan.ha.mir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَمَرَ (inhamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
